scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @onto/api" "npm run dev -w @onto/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @onto/api && npm run build -w @onto/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @onto/domain && npm run typecheck -w @onto/extractor-sdk && npm run typecheck -w @onto/extractors-openapi && npm run typecheck -w @onto/api && npm run typecheck -w @onto/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @onto/domain && npm run test -w @onto/extractors-openapi && npm run test -w @onto/api
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @onto/web && npm run lint -w @onto/api
